name: scope-harness
description: Turns vague requests into a scoped task brief with done criteria, a budget, and a recommended model and effort level.

mode.title: Clarification mode
mode.description: ask: ask up to 3 questions when a key gap remains. infer: never ask, list assumptions instead. auto: ask only for broad or high-stakes requests.

threshold.title: Vagueness threshold
threshold.description: Score from 0 to 10 at which the hook suggests sharpening. Higher means fewer nudges.
